name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with xTool Studio LinuxBox

## Environment

- LinuxBox release or commit
- Host OS and version
- Desktop and session type (X11 or Wayland)
- GPU and installer graphics option
- xTool Studio version
- xTool device model and connection type, if relevant

## Steps to reproduce

Describe what you ran, what you expected, and what happened.

## Relevant log output

Include the part of `~/.cache/xtool-studio-cachy-box/install.log` or `launch.log` around the first error. Remove private paths, device identifiers, and account details before posting.
